points: Yirmiyahu now prophesies against Bavel, the superpower that destroyed the Beis HaMikdash.
"Don't be afraid" may be addressed to himself; this was his most dangerous prophecy.
A nation from the north, Persia under Coresh, will destroy Bavel like Sedom.
The Jewish people will return weeping in teshuva, and Persia will let them rebuild.
Hashem will look for their sins and not find them: complete forgiveness, as if nothing was ever wrong.
